remarks: Spacious and quiet one bedroom unit on the top floor of the sought-after Hyde Park Condominium complex. Upon entry there is a comfortably sized updated kitchen including a gas stove, refrigerator, dishwasher with an attractive open concept pass-through to the large Living Room/Dining Room combination. On the left side is a hallway leading to a large storage closet, a newly updated bathroom, and the well-proportioned bedroom with its own large closet. Attractive shiny Parquet flooring is found throughout the unit with all windows looking out to a relaxed treed view of a peaceful residential neighborhood. Located near the middle of Springdale, this unit is a short walk to the Springdale Train Station, restaurants, shopping, schools, sports facilities, and public transportation to downtown Stamford. The Merritt Parkway and Sterling Farms Golf Public Course are less than a five-minute drive and an easy route to I-95 is nearby. The monthly rent includes heat, hot water, water and cooking gas. The parking space is a nearby limited access semi-private indoor parking space in the attached garage and is only a few steps from the beautiful main floor Lobby. A second, outdoor space could be added. The main floor Lobby also includes a large gym and convenient mail room. The complex allows one cat and no dogs.
